applies_why: This judge text resolves the Isaiah 7:14 link against CR2 and DR3 by comparing CR2's answer with DR3's pressing on the sign's own bounds, so it is deciding the kind of chain collision K-C governs.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: 'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse': I weighed (1) weighing the whole pressed chain by its support/footing against (2) isolating the Isaiah 7:14 sign verse's own statement; the judge did the latter.
why: By treating 'the sign itself does not state the mechanism' as decisive, the judge applies the retired stating-verse test rather than weighing the pressed witnesses chain-against-chain by footing.
